question: As per the Census of 2011, the literacy rate of India is _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**74.04%**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Census of 2011:-**

 
 
• The literacy rate of India as per the Census of 2011 is 0.7404, which means that 74.04% of the population is literate.
 
• This is an improvement from the 2001 Census, where the literacy rate was 64.83%.
 
• The literacy rate is higher in urban areas (84.1%) compared to rural areas (68.9%).
 
• Kerala has the highest literacy rate among all the states in India with 96.2%, while Bihar has the lowest with 63.8%.
